announcements.title: Halloween Live Event
announcements.summary: The village sky turns Halloween dusk. The haunted house and the pumpkin meadow are waiting.
body: From October 1 through November 7, CappyWorld wears its Halloween light: a purple-orange dusk, stars a little earlier, and the same soft park you already know. It is the season already built into the game, not a separate mode.

Walk north from Mochi's home into the village, then west across the bridge to the haunted house in Whispering forest. The ghost inside only floats. East of home, the pumpkin meadow is full of pumpkins and hay bales you can knock over.
Bring a grown-up if you like. Nothing jumps out, and nothing ends the day. Hop, flop, say hello, and wander back before the moon is high.

announcements.title: Friends in the same park
announcements.summary: Open Play on two browsers or devices and join the park — you can see each other hop around.
body: Name your capybara, then join the park. Anyone else on the site at the same time shows up as a friend nearby.
If the lobby cannot be reached, the game still works solo.

announcements.title: Name your capybara
announcements.summary: When you press Play, type a name and pick a male or female capybara. Your name floats above you in the park.
body: The village now asks who you are before you walk in. Type a name, choose a male capybara (a bit bigger) or a female capybara (with a flower), then join the park.
Your name sits over your capybara so friends can tell you apart. Clothes and coins still stay in this browser. Pause, then Save code, if you want a copy you can paste back later.

announcements.title: New neighbors in the square
announcements.summary: Juniper the courier and Sable the carpenter are in the village, and the notice board posts a new job each day.
body: Juniper waits by the notice board. Sable hangs around the first plot sign and will ask you to claim land, haul planks, and raise a cottage.
The notice board picks one small job for the day. Finish it, or leave it; a new note is up after midnight in the game clock.

announcements.title: Play in the browser
announcements.summary: The same CappyWorld village from this project runs on the Play page. No install.
body: Open Play, wait for the park to load, then press Play on the game menu. WASD or the arrows walk. Space hops. F flops. E, or the Go button, talks, enters a gate, or picks up clothes.
Clothes and coins stay in this browser. Pause, then Save code, if you want to keep a copy you can paste back later.
